entries.label: 새싹콩
entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one friendly sprout-bean game character in the same softly painted sprite style as the reference sheets. The sheets are supporting identity/style references only. Cream round bean body, exactly two dark green bead eyes, no mouth, two tiny cream feet. Its living green leaves form one continuous snug mantle from a shared crown. On the left are three thick overlapping succulent leaves. On the right is one broad curved cupped leaf, with a thin sickle-shaped outer margin; its reinforced upper midrib ends in one long pointed leaf tip. These four traits must fit together as the anatomy of one plant: curved leaf edge, pointed midrib, thick protective leaves, broad sheltering leaf. Keep the face open. No nectar drops, yellow spots, extra eye dots, equipment, handles, straps, letters, effects or detached pieces. One neutral pose facing slightly right. Entire character centered with generous clear padding. Transparent background.

entries.label: 몽돌
entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE actual neutral source key drawing for a FOUR-combat-attribute combination in a small 2D game.
Input image 1: approved three-attribute comparison sheet, as the identity and coherent anatomical integration authority. Input image 2: approved single-attribute atlas, as material, palette and functional shape vocabulary. Both are supporting references, NOT output layouts.
Create exactly ONE complete character with ONLY the four selected attributes. Preserve the approved species and resolve all shared roots, intersections, proportions and silhouette together. One dominant continuous anatomical/material construction, sparse subordinate details, broad quiet surfaces. Do not pile four full accessories on a body, and do not import the fifth unselected attribute.
One neutral ready pose, mostly frontal with slight rightward orientation. Match the softly painted casual-game sprite style, thin crisp dark outlines, upper-left lighting, face, proportions and materials. Full subject centered on a square canvas with generous transparent padding; no edge touching or cropping.
Exactly TWO eyes, no mouth. Genuine transparent background. No labels, letters, diagrams, shadows, ground, loose particles, effects, extra poses, costumes, straps, held equipment, metal hardware, realistic anatomy or 3D toy rendering. Draw complete clean surfaces and naturally fitted connections. This is actual source artwork awaiting review, not an animation preview.

SPECIES: Warm ochre-beige rounded gently faceted pebble, exactly two dark bead eyes, no mouth, two tiny tan stone feet. Matte calm parent stone remains most of the central body. Precious minerals are one naturally intergrown shoulder/back formation.No necklace around the face.
SELECTED ATTRIBUTES ONLY: blade + piercing + carapace + guard (칼날 + 관통 + 갑피 + 엄호).
INTEGRATED CONSTRUCTION: One compact low sapphire protective crust crosses the upper back and interlocks on the right with one broad rose-quartz buttress. The buttress's outer cleavage has a thin emerald-green cutting edge, and its upper ridge tapers into ONE amethyst-purple prism. Shared seams and fitted facets join all four mineral functions in one formation. Quiet ochre face and lower contour, no amber chambers or droplets.
